last.verdict: Alani Nu drove record sales, but the flagship CELSIUS brand shrank again and rising costs kept profit flat.

takeaways.label: Flagship still shrinking
takeaways.text: CELSIUS brand revenue fell about 6% to $356.8M and its retail sales fell 7%. The company blamed fewer products, inventory timing and weak club-store sales. Alani Nu rose 24% to $410.1M.

takeaways.label: Margins keep sliding
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 46.8% versus 51.3% a year ago, hurt by aluminum and fuel costs and more sales through PepsiCo. Adjusted EBITDA fell 3% despite 17% higher revenue.

takeaways.label: Growth isn't reaching profit
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS was $0.41 versus $0.42 a year ago. Revenue grew 17% to $847.2M, helped by the Rockstar acquisition ($80.3M this quarter).

takeaways.label: Leadership reshuffle
takeaways.text: A new brand-led structure puts Alex Zigliara in charge of CELSIUS and Rishi Daing over Rockstar and emerging brands, aimed at fixing the flagship and margins.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
